description: Fix missing and incorrect Python dependencies in requirements.txt. You have inherited a Python data analysis project at /home/ga/workspace/data_analysis that has import errors. The main script is analyze_data.py which imports several packages, but requirements.txt is incomplete and contains an outdated package name. Your task: (1) Open the project in VSCode, (2) Try running 'python analyze_data.py' in the integrated terminal to see import errors, (3) Identify the missing packages from the error messages, (4) Open requirements.txt and add the missing package 'requests', (5) Fix the incorrect package name - the package should be 'scikit-learn' not 'sklearn' (this is a common Python packaging issue: you import from sklearn but install scikit-learn), (6) Keep all original packages (pandas, numpy, matplotlib) in the file, (7) Save requirements.txt. You can verify your fix works by running 'python test_imports.py' which will test all imports. The file must contain: requests, scikit-learn (not sklearn), pandas, numpy, and matplotlib.
